messages:
Maria L.: quick heads-up — while onboarding redwood-neo-13b-int4v2 on longtrain suite I hit a reproducible divergence around token ~2048. reproducible with same seed. :thinking_face:
Maria L.: repro command:
```bash
./scripts/run_longtrain.sh --model redwood-neo-13b-int4v2 --ctx 65536 --prompt tests/long_prompt_2k.txt --seed 42 --steps 4096
```
Maria L.: attached snippet from inference log (trimmed):
```
[INFER] step=1024 token_idx=512 expected="the" got="a"   # divergence start
[KV] prefill-pos=0 postfill-pos=512 cache-wrote=512 cache-read-offset=0
[ROTARY] layer=10 base=10000 phase=0.785423 -> 0.792102 (jump)
```
Maria L.: hypothesis: RoPE phase scaling drifting when prefill crosses certain boundary, causing KV alignment shift. seems quantized path only (fp16 run matched baseline).
Yusuf K.: can you dump raw KV indices + rotary angles at the moment before divergence? `tools/dump_kv.py --pos 2000 --layer 10` should work. also paste the quant config (scale factors, group size).
Maria L.: dumping now, pushing to s3://redwood-dev/triage/3001122334/kv-dump.tar.gz
Maria L.: quant config: `qtype=int4v2, group=128, scale=per-channel, dequant-shift=true`
Shreya P.: did you try toggling `rotary_scale` (the compile-time flag)? we had a similar sounding failure when model compiled with one base but runtime used default.
Evan R.: run a quick bisect: toggle `rotary_rescale=true/false` and `kv_prefill=true/false` to isolate whether it's RoPE or prefill interaction. I'll spin a job on gpu-sdc-4.
Evan R.: sample bisect matrix I'll run:
```text
A: rotary_rescale=true, kv_prefill=true
B: rotary_rescale=false, kv_prefill=true
C: rotary_rescale=true, kv_prefill=false
D: rotary_rescale=false, kv_prefill=false
```
Yusuf K.: if B passes and A fails -> compile/runtime scale mismatch. if both A/B fail but C/D pass -> prefill+kv stash interaction.
Maria L.: FYI fp16 baseline: matched reference up to 8k tokens (no drift). int4v2 diverges consistently.
ciara-bot: job queued: `bisect-longtrain-3001122334` on gpu-sdc-4 (ETA ~12m) :robot_face:
Evan R.: saw job complete, quick results: A fail, B pass, C fail, D pass.
Evan R.: that pattern points to `rotary_rescale=true` being the culprit when combined with kv_prefill. B pass (rescale=false, prefill=true) — interesting.
Shreya P.: sounds like compile-time scaling applied twice in runtime for int4 path. maybe dequant-shift interacts with rescale factor. can you attach the compiler flags used for the int4 build?
Maria L.: compiler flags: `--rotary-base=10000 --rotary-rescale=true --quant-mode=int4v2 --fuse-kv-prefill`
Yusuf K.: ok reproducer looks tiny, i'll try a quick patch: force `rotary_rescale` to be a compile-only flag (strip runtime scaling) and run the same test. if that fixes, bug's in runtime path applying rescale again for quantized kernels.
Maria L.: opened issue #INFR-812 with logs and kv dump link. added reproducer script and bisect matrix. tagging eng-runtime and compilers.
Evan R.: temporary mitigation: rollout canary with `rotary_rescale=false` for int4 models until patch lands. perf impact ~+2% but prevents quality regression.
Shreya P.: I'll add an eval job to run our longctx goldset (5k prompts) against canary and baseline to quantify regressions.
Maria L.: thanks all — will follow up in the ticket with any further diffs. :thumbsup:
